mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, which can potentiate irbesartan's hypotensive effects and increase risk of severe hypertensive crisis if sympathomimetic amines are present or through indirect sympathomimetic mechanisms.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; use combination cautiously and consider alternative antidepressant; educate patient on dietary tyramine restriction and avoid sympathomimetic medications.
